defs.def: the layer of tissue that covers the body 皮；皮肤

ex.s: When the final bell rang in June, I walked away with a yearbook full of messages about writing’s most powerful significance — the ability to connect people, to put us in another’s skin, to teach us what it means to be human.
ex.t: 当六月的下课铃响起，我带着一本写满留言的年鉴离开，那些话道出了写作最强大的意义——把人们连接起来、让我们设身处地、教会我们生而为人的含义。

ex.s: Sometimes I think no matter where we come from, what colour our eyes, hair and skin, we are here to show our understanding and help.
ex.t: 有时我想，无论我们来自哪里，无论眼睛、头发和皮肤是什么颜色，我们来到这里都是为了表达理解并提供帮助。

ex.s: With our tender, hopeful skin, that is where we begin.
ex.t: 用我们温柔充满希望的皮肤我们在那里重新开始。

ex.s: Now I go dipping almost every day, and I’ve come to long for that moment when the cold becomes a second skin and my internal voice goes silent.
ex.t: 现在我几乎每天都去泡冷水浴，并开始渴望那一刻：寒冷变成第二层皮肤，我内心的声音归于沉寂。

ex.s: I still have light skin and black hair, of course.
ex.t: 当然，我依然是白皙的皮肤和黑头发。

ex.s: Seconds later, our lizard emerged from its tank with its old skin flowing behind it.
ex.t: 几秒钟后我们的蜥蜴从箱子里钻了出来旧皮跟在身后飘动。

ex.s: Its unique feature, from which it gets its name, is the bright red skin on the top of its head.
ex.t: 它的独特特征——也是它名字的由来——是头顶上鲜红色的皮肤。

ex.s: 40    While the sun's rays can age and harm our skin, they also give is beneficial Vitamin D.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 40    虽然阳光会使我们的皮肤老化和受损，但它也给我们提供有益的维生素D。

ex.s: My classmates ranged from those kids with pale skin and large blue eyes to those with rich brown skin and dark hair.
ex.t: 我的同学从皮肤苍白、蓝眼睛的孩子到深棕色皮肤、黑头发的孩子都有。

ex.s: I reported the strange surface on the skin of the lizard to my husband and children the next morning.
ex.t: 第二天早上我把蜥蜴皮肤上的异常情况报告给了丈夫和孩子。

ex.s: It takes sunscreen about fifteen minutes to start working, and that's plenty of time for your skin to absorb a day's worth of Vitamin D.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 这需要15分钟的防晒霜才能开始工作,那么你的皮肤就有足够的时间吸收一天的维生素D.

ex.s: Remove the skin and place them in plastic bags or containers and freeze.
ex.t: 她的皮肤仍然光滑，头发依然乌黑直顺，慢跑让她保持了苗条和健康。

ex.s: To make sure you get enough Vitamin D—but still protect your skin— put on sunscreen right as you head outside.
ex.src: 2019全国I卷·Is Fresh Air Really Good for You?
ex.t: 为了确保你获得足够的维生素D——同时保护你的皮肤——出门时立即涂上防晒霜。

ex.s: She still has smooth skin and straight black hair, and jogging has kept her slim and fit.
ex.t: 她依然皮肤光滑、一头顺直的黑发，慢跑让她保持苗条健美。

defs.def: having the type of skin mentioned 构成形容词
the skin of a dead animal with or without its fur, used for making leather, etc. 常构成复合词

ex.s: It was then known as cuju (kick ball), a game using a ball of animal skins with hair inside.
ex.t: 当六月最后的铃声敲响，我带着一本写满留言的年鉴离开，那些留言讲述了写作最强大的意义——连接人们的能力，让我们能设身处地（进入他人的肌肤），教会我们作为人的含义。

defs.def: the outer layer of some fruits and vegetables （某些果实和蔬菜的）皮，壳
the thin outer layer of a sausage 外皮；肠衣
the thin layer that forms on the surface of some liquids, especially when they become cold （尤指冷却时形成的）薄层，皮
a layer that covers the outside of sth 外壳；外层
a special cover for any small electronic device that you can carry with you so that you can listen to music （便携式电子音乐播放器的）护套，保护壳
the interface of a computer program (= the way a computer program presents information on screen), that the user can change to suit their particular preferences 电脑程式的用户界面（可按个人喜好变换）

ex.s: Freedom Day is held every year on 27 April to celebrate South Africa’s first fully-participated elections in 1994, in which everyone was allowed to vote regardless of skin colour.
ex.t: 每年4月27日是自由日，庆祝南非1994年首次全民参与的选举，在这次选举中，无论肤色如何，每个人都被允许投票。

defs.def: to take the skin off an animal, a fruit or a vegetable 剥皮；扒皮；削皮
to rub the skin off part of your body by accident 擦破（身体某部位的）皮肤
